scripts.prebuild:pkg: node scripts/verify-build-node.js && node scripts/resolve-build-version.js --version-json build-version.json && node scripts/stage-better-sqlite3-binding.js
scripts.build:win64: npm run prebuild:pkg && npx --no-install pkg package.json --sea --targets node24.22.1-win-x64 --output talktome_win64 && node scripts/copy-runtime-deps.js win64
scripts.build:mac_arm64: npm run prebuild:pkg && npx --no-install pkg package.json --sea --targets node24.22.1-macos-arm64 --output talktome_arm64 && node scripts/copy-runtime-deps.js mac_arm64
